description: This file defines an interface IBlobContainerFactory for creating blob container clients for Azure Blob Storage, along with a default implementation class DefaultBlobContainerFactory that manages container initialization and retrieval based on storage options.

classes.name: DefaultBlobContainerFactory
classes.description: Provides a default implementation of IBlobContainerFactory, managing a default container and its initialization using provided storage options.

methods.name: GetBlobContainerClient
methods.description: Returns the stored BlobContainerClient for the specified grainId (currently returns the default container).

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the default container by creating it if it does not exist, using the given BlobServiceClient.
